title: Storage Beds
descriptionHtml:
A storage bed keeps bedding, clothes and suitcases inside the bed itself. UK storage beds come in two main types: the ottoman storage bed, where the whole mattress platform lifts on gas struts to open one large compartment, and the divan bed with drawers, where drawers pull out of the base for everyday things. Ours are handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop on solid wood frames, from the Divan Storage Base with Drawers at £168.99 and the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base at £220.99, with free delivery across Great Britain by our own team.

Short on space? A side lift ottoman opens from the long side, so the bed can sit foot-to-wall; drawers need about 60cm of clear floor. A small double (4ft) saves width if space is tight. See the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base from £249.99.

Storage beds give you extra space without extra furniture. Choose a gas lift ottoman bed for storage under the whole mattress, or a bed with built-in drawers for everyday access, all handmade to order in Dewsbury with free delivery across Great Britain.

Not quite right? Go straight to ottoman beds, storage beds with drawers or ottoman divan bases.

Storage bed buying guide

Ottoman (gas lift) storage

Also called a lift-up storage bed: the mattress platform lifts on gas struts to reveal one large compartment. Best for bulky, occasional items such as spare duvets, suitcases and seasonal clothes. Needs clear space above the bed to open. See ottoman beds, including end-lift and side-lift options, or shop by size: small double ottoman beds and king size ottoman beds.

Drawer storage

Drawers built into the base, ideal for things you use every day. Needs clear floor space in front of the drawers. See storage beds with drawers.

Storage box

For extra storage at the foot of the bed, see the Upholstered Ottoman Storage Box.

Sizes and fabrics

Made in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT), upholstered in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, usually with a matching headboard.

Frequently asked questions

What is an ottoman storage bed?

An ottoman storage bed has a mattress platform that lifts on gas struts and stays open, opening the full space under the bed. Choose end lift or side lift to suit your room. See our gas lift ottoman beds.

What is a divan bed with drawers?

It is an upholstered divan base with drawers built into it, so you can pull out clothes or linen without lifting the mattress. Leave clear floor in front of the drawers. Start with the Divan Storage Base with Drawers (from £168.99), or see complete beds in storage beds with drawers.

Do you deliver storage beds across the UK?

Our own team delivers free to your door or downstairs anywhere in England, Scotland and Wales. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Room of Choice Drop Off (£29.99) and Room of Choice Assembly (£69.99) are optional extras at checkout.

Which gives more storage: ottoman or drawers?

An ottoman uses the space under the whole bed in one compartment. Drawers divide the space into sections that are quicker to reach every day.

Can I use my own mattress?

Yes. Any standard UK mattress in the matching size will fit.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a bed?

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and a faulty item is replaced free or fully refunded. See our returns policy.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Can I spread the cost?

Yes. Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout, subject to the provider's eligibility checks.

Handmade to order in Dewsbury · solid wood frames · free delivery across Great Britain (Northern Ireland £90), usually in 3–5 working days · 14-day free returns · 5-year warranty · free fabric swatches · Klarna and Clearpay available.
